themes_detail.label: Tree Damage & Overgrowth Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks, +2300%), while dead/dying tree complaints hit 8 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.6 weekly average, +1180%), and overgrown branches complaints reached 6 LAST WEEK (vs. 0.6 weekly average, +860%), suggesting either severe weather damage, negligent tree maintenance, or contractor activity affecting the district's canopy.
evidence: Illegal Tree Damage: 3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 8.69)
Dead/Dying Tree: 8 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 8.61)
Overgrown Tree/Branches: 6 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 7.72)
reporting_angles: Interview residents experiencing tree damage; identify if a single contractor or weather event is responsible
Investigate Parks Department response times and tree maintenance protocols in CD 309

themes_detail.label: Construction-Related Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: General Construction/Plumbing complaints exploded to 67 LAST WEEK (vs. 11.5 weekly average over 8 weeks, +483% increase, z-score: 7.99), coinciding with THE CITY's recent reporting on pile-driving complaints and structural damage—suggesting active major construction is impacting the neighborhood.
evidence: General Construction/Plumbing complaints: 67 LAST WEEK vs. 11.5 weekly average (z-score: 7.99, +483%)
325 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (213 alterations, 68 new buildings, 7 full demolitions)
THE CITY reporting on pile-driving damage to walls and structural cracks (2026-05-14)
reporting_angles: Identify the specific projects triggering pile-driving complaints and track DOB compliance actions
Interview affected residents about property damage and construction impact on daily life

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (likely Uber/Lyft/app-based services) jumped to 8 THIS WEEK (vs. 1.2 weekly average over 8 weeks, +540% increase, z-score: 6.19), indicating emerging street-level issues with ride-hailing operations in the district.
evidence: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints: 8 THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.19, +540%)
Streetsblog NYC recently covered transit/bus lane issues in the Flatbush Ave. corridor (2026-05-14)
reporting_angles: Analyze complaint types (double-parking, congestion, unsafe pickup/dropoff) to identify specific grievances
Interview residents and business owners about traffic and street obstruction from ride-hailing services

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Violation of Park Rules complaints spiked to 4 LAST WEEK (vs. 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks, +967% increase, z-score: 7.49), suggesting either enforcement activity or emerging misuse of Prospect Park or other green spaces that aligns with CB's standing request to improve park access.
evidence: Violation of Park Rules: 4 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, +967%)
Community Board has standing budget request to improve access to parks and amenities (Department of Parks and Recreation)
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Dept. to understand what violations are being reported and enforcement focus areas
Interview park-goers and CB members about park maintenance and safety concerns
